title: pid counts an hmmer hit on its sequence or best domain score
body:
## What exists today

pid ranks each run's hits by their best E-value per (target, query), in `best` in `benchmarks/pid/src/parse.rs`. For hmmer that is the full sequence E-value.

## The change

Try hmmer's recall in every pid figure with a hit counted on whichever of its sequence score or its best domain score is better. This matches the rule recall's `coverage` uses since `f1838ea`.
